description: Impianti Fotovoltaici CGE is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.comune.genova.it. The dataset contains information on the location of photovoltaic systems on buildings owned by the Municipality of Genoa and for use by dealers. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "CGE Photovoltaic Systems" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Edifici, rinnovabile, fotovoltaico, energia. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
